summary: Batch ZIP workflows and precise control over image dimensions, transparency and file names.

features.title: ZIP folder processing
features.short: Optimise a complete folder tree in one archive
features.description: Upload a ZIP through the main upload area, clear the previous batch, optimise every supported image and download a new ZIP with the same folders, subfolders and untouched non-image files.

features.title: Resolution and transparency
features.short: Resize images and control transparent pixels
features.description: Set width and height with optional aspect-ratio preservation, and choose whether transparent pixels stay transparent or are placed on a white background.

features.title: Bulk rename
features.short: Apply complete naming rules to every image
features.description: Add a prefix or suffix, force lower- or uppercase, replace spaces with hyphens or underscores, and replace or remove matching text. Rename-only mode leaves every image byte unchanged.

features.title: Public access and saved preferences
features.short: Choose public tools and remember each profile's setup
features.description: The administrator decides which Premium tools appear on the Apps Hub public page. Enabled users keep their choices locally per profile and can reset them to defaults at any time.
